paragraphs.en: On the morning of August 13th, I left home in a hurry. The sky had been overcast since dawn, and a light rain was already falling. I had not brought an umbrella, and soon my coat was wet. I felt annoyed, for I had planned a pleasant walk to the shops.
paragraphs.zh: 八月十三日早晨，我匆匆忙忙地离开了家。从黎明开始，天空就一直布满阴云，小雨已经下了起来。我没有带雨伞，很快外衣就湿了。我感到很恼火，因为我原本计划高高兴兴地去商店逛一逛。

vocabulary.meaning: adj. 阴天的；布满阴云的
vocabulary.example: The sky was overcast, and we decided to stay inside.
vocabulary.derivatives: overcast (adj.) → overcast sky 阴天；overcast (v.) 使变阴

vocabulary.example: He left the house in a hurry and forgot his keys.
vocabulary.derivatives: in a hurry to do sth 急于做某事；in no hurry 不着急

vocabulary.example: She was annoyed with herself for making the same mistake.
vocabulary.derivatives: annoy (v.) 使恼怒 → annoyance (n.) 恼怒 → annoyed (adj.) → annoying (adj.) 烦人的

difficult_sentences.en: The sky had been overcast since dawn, and a light rain was already falling.
difficult_sentences.zh: 从黎明开始，天空就一直布满阴云，小雨已经下了起来。
difficult_sentences.grammar: 本句为并列句。前半部分用过去完成时 had been overcast 表示从黎明之前就开始并持续到过去某一时刻的状态，since dawn 强调起点。后半部分用过去进行时 was falling 描写当时正在进行的动作。
difficult_sentences.pattern: had been + 形容词/名词 + since + 时间点，and + 主语 + was/were + 现在分词 (过去时间背景描写)
difficult_sentences.note: since dawn 用于完成时，表示‘自黎明以来’；而 for dawn 是错误表达。注意过去完成时常与 since 或 for 引导的时间状语连用。

chunks.en: On the morning of August 13th
chunks.zh: 在八月十三日早晨

chunks.en: I left home in a hurry
chunks.zh: 我匆匆离开家

chunks.en: The sky had been overcast since dawn, and a light rain was already falling
chunks.zh: 从黎明起天空一直阴沉，小雨已经落下

chunks.en: I had not brought an umbrella, and soon my coat was wet
chunks.zh: 我没带伞，很快外套就湿了

chunks.en: I felt annoyed, for I had planned a pleasant walk to the shops
chunks.zh: 我感到恼火，因为我原本计划愉快地走去商店
chunks.function: 主句 + for 引导的原因状语从句

points.explanation: 过去完成时表示‘过去的过去’，常用于说明在某一过去时间之前已经发生的动作或状态。本句 The sky had been overcast since dawn 表明阴天状态在 dawn 之前已经开始，并延续到叙述的过去时刻。
points.example_sentence: The sky had been overcast since dawn, and a light rain was already falling.
points.common_mistake: ❌ The sky has been overcast since dawn (误用现在完成时) → ✅ The sky had been overcast since dawn (过去时间背景用过去完成时)
points.contrast: 过去完成时与现在完成时：现在完成时强调对现在的影响，过去完成时强调对过去某一时刻的影响。如 I had finished lunch when he came 表示他到来时我已吃完午饭。

paragraphs.en: As I turned a corner, I noticed an old man standing beneath a shop awning. He was playing a violin, his eyes closed and his body swaying gently. Most passers-by hurried past without a glance. Yet his music rose above the noise of the traffic, calm and unhurried.
paragraphs.zh: 当我转过一个街角时，我注意到一位老人站在商店的遮阳篷下。他正在拉小提琴，双眼闭着，身体轻轻摇晃。大多数行人都匆忙走过，看也不看一眼。然而，他的琴声却升腾于交通喧嚣之上，从容而舒缓。

vocabulary.example: We sat under the awning to escape the hot sun.
vocabulary.derivatives: shop awning 商店遮阳篷；canvas awning 帆布雨篷

vocabulary.example: He took a quick glance at the headlines before leaving.
vocabulary.derivatives: glance (v.) 瞥一眼 → cast a glance 投以一瞥；at first glance 乍一看

vocabulary.meaning: adj. 从容的；不慌不忙的
vocabulary.example: She walked with an unhurried pace, enjoying the evening air.
vocabulary.derivatives: hurried (adj.) 匆忙的 → unhurried (adj.) 从容的反义词 → unhurriedly (adv.) 从容地

difficult_sentences.en: As I turned a corner, I noticed an old man standing beneath a shop awning.
difficult_sentences.zh: 当我转过一个街角时，我注意到一位老人站在商店的遮阳篷下。
difficult_sentences.grammar: 句首为 as 引导的时间状语从句，主句谓语 noticed 后接宾语 an old man，再接现在分词短语 standing beneath a shop awning 作宾语补足语，表示主动且正在进行的动作。
difficult_sentences.pattern: notice + 名词/代词 + 现在分词 (感官动词 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语)
difficult_sentences.note: 感官动词 (see, notice, hear, feel 等) 后接复合宾语时，不定式表全过程，现在分词表正在进行。注意不能说 notice sb doing sth 时省略 to do 的正确形式是 do，不是 to do。

chunks.en: As I turned a corner
chunks.zh: 当我转过街角

chunks.en: I noticed an old man standing beneath a shop awning
chunks.zh: 我注意到一位老人站在商店遮阳篷下
chunks.function: 主句 (谓语 + 宾语 + 宾语补足语)

chunks.en: He was playing a violin, his eyes closed and his body swaying gently
chunks.zh: 他正拉小提琴，闭着眼，身体轻轻摇摆
chunks.function: 主句 + 独立主格结构作伴随状语

chunks.en: Most passers-by hurried past without a glance
chunks.zh: 多数路人匆匆走过，看也不看

chunks.en: Yet his music rose above the noise of the traffic, calm and unhurried
chunks.zh: 然而他的琴声升起于交通喧嚣之上，从容而舒缓
chunks.function: 主句 + 形容词短语作伴随状语

points.explanation: 独立主格结构由名词/代词 + 现在分词/过去分词/形容词/介词短语等构成，在句中作伴随状语，表示动作同时进行。本句 his eyes closed and his body swaying gently 是独立主格，closed 为过去分词，swaying 为现在分词。
points.example_sentence: He was playing a violin, his eyes closed and his body swaying gently.
points.common_mistake: ❌ He was playing a violin, his eyes closing and his body swaying gently (close 在此是及物动词，眼睛‘被闭上’，应用过去分词) → ✅ his eyes closed
points.contrast: 独立主格与 with 复合结构：两者都可表伴随，但 with 复合结构更口语化，如 with his eyes closed。独立主格多用于书面，句子更简练。

paragraphs.en: I stopped and listened. The tune was unfamiliar, but it spoke of patience and quiet joy. For five minutes I forgot my damp coat and my hurried plans. When the music ended, I put a few coins into his open case. He nodded and smiled, as if we shared a secret.
paragraphs.zh: 我停下来倾听。这支曲子我并不熟悉，但它诉说着耐心与宁静的喜悦。整整五分钟，我忘记了自己潮湿的外衣和匆忙的计划。当音乐停止时，我向他的琴盒里放了几枚硬币。他点点头，笑了笑，仿佛我们共享着一个秘密。

vocabulary.example: The child hummed a cheerful tune all the way home.
vocabulary.derivatives: tune (n.) 曲调 → tune (v.) 调音 → tuneful (adj.) 悦耳的 → tuneless (adj.) 不成调的

vocabulary.example: The towel was still damp from the rain.
vocabulary.derivatives: damp (adj.) 潮湿的 → dampness (n.) 潮湿 → dampen (v.) 使潮湿；使沮丧

vocabulary.example: She looked at me as if she knew the answer.
vocabulary.derivatives: as if 引导方式状语从句；as though 同义；可用于虚拟语气：as if she were right (真实情况不是这样)

difficult_sentences.en: He nodded and smiled, as if we shared a secret.
difficult_sentences.zh: 他点点头，笑了笑，仿佛我们共享着一个秘密。
difficult_sentences.grammar: as if 引导方式状语从句，表示与事实相反或想象中的情况时，从句用虚拟语气。句子用过去式 shared 表示与现在事实相反（实际上我们刚刚认识，并无共同秘密）。
difficult_sentences.pattern: 主语 + 谓语, as if + 主语 + 过去式… (与现在事实相反的虚拟语气)
difficult_sentences.note: as if = as though。口语中（尤其美式英语）也可用陈述语气表示可能真实的情况，如 It looks as if it is going to rain。但在正式书面语中，非真实情况仍用虚拟语气。

chunks.en: I stopped and listened
chunks.zh: 我停下来聆听

chunks.en: The tune was unfamiliar, but it spoke of patience and quiet joy
chunks.zh: 曲调不熟悉，却诉说着耐心与宁静的喜悦

chunks.en: For five minutes I forgot my damp coat and my hurried plans
chunks.zh: 五分钟里，我忘了湿外套和匆忙的计划
chunks.function: 主句 (For five minutes 为时间状语)

chunks.en: When the music ended, I put a few coins into his open case
chunks.zh: 乐声停止时，我向他的琴盒里放了几个硬币
chunks.function: 时间状语从句 + 主句

chunks.en: He nodded and smiled, as if we shared a secret
chunks.zh: 他点头微笑，仿佛我们共享秘密
chunks.function: 主句 + as if 引导的方式状语从句

points.structure: as if 引导的虚拟方式状语从句
points.explanation: 当 as if 引导的从句表示的内容与事实不符或仅是想象时，从句需用虚拟语气。与现在事实相反用一般过去时，与过去事实相反用过去完成时。本句 as if we shared a secret 用 shared，属于与现在事实相反。
points.example_sentence: He nodded and smiled, as if we shared a secret.
points.common_mistake: ❌ He nods and smiles, as if we share a secret (在 non-factual 语境中用陈述语气) → ✅ He nods and smiles, as if we shared a secret.
points.contrast: as if 也可接不定式短语 as if to say，表示‘好像要……’。如 He opened his mouth as if to speak。

paragraphs.en: That morning taught me a simple lesson. We hurry from one place to another, but we rarely notice the world around us. A little pause, a single melody, can change the feel of an entire day. I walked home slowly, with the rain no longer an annoyance but a gentle reminder of the beauty we often miss.
paragraphs.zh: 那个早晨给我上了简单的一课。我们从一个地方匆匆赶往另一个地方，却很少留意周围的世界。片刻的驻足，一段简单的旋律，就能改变一整天的感受。我慢慢地走回家，雨不再是恼人的事，而是我们常常错过的美丽景色的一种温柔提示。

vocabulary.example: We rarely visit the museum, even though it is close.
vocabulary.derivatives: rare (adj.) 稀少的 → rarely (adv.) 很少 = seldom → rarity (n.) 稀有

vocabulary.meaning: n. 恼怒；烦恼，讨厌的事
vocabulary.example: The constant noise was a great annoyance to the residents.
vocabulary.derivatives: annoy (v.) 使恼怒 → annoyed (adj.) 恼怒的 → annoying (adj.) 烦人的 → annoyance (n.)

vocabulary.meaning: n. 令人想起……的东西；提示，提醒物
vocabulary.example: The old photograph was a reminder of happier times.
vocabulary.derivatives: remind (v.) 提醒 → reminder (n.) 提示；remind sb of sth 使某人想起某事

difficult_sentences.en: I walked home slowly, with the rain no longer an annoyance but a gentle reminder of the beauty we often miss.
difficult_sentences.zh: 我慢慢地走回家，雨不再是恼人的事，而是我们常常错过的美丽景色的一种温柔提示。
difficult_sentences.grammar: with + the rain + no longer an annoyance but a gentle reminder 构成 with 复合结构。其中 the rain 是宾语，no longer...but... 连接两个名词短语作宾语补足语。介词短语 of the beauty we often miss 作 reminder 的定语，we often miss 是省略关系代词 that 的定语从句。
difficult_sentences.pattern: with + 宾语 + 名词短语 (作宾语补足语) + 定语从句 (省略 that)
difficult_sentences.note: with 复合结构常在句中作伴随状语或原因状语。注意‘不再……而是……’用 no longer...but...，不能误用 not longer。类似结构还有 not...but...。

chunks.en: That morning taught me a simple lesson
chunks.zh: 那个早晨给我上了一堂简单的课
chunks.function: 主句 (双宾语结构 me, a lesson)

chunks.en: We hurry from one place to another, but we rarely notice the world around us
chunks.zh: 我们匆匆从一处赶往另一处，却很少留意周围的世界

chunks.en: A little pause, a single melody, can change the feel of an entire day
chunks.zh: 片刻驻足，一段旋律，能改变一整天的感受

chunks.en: I walked home slowly
chunks.zh: 我慢慢地走回家

chunks.en: with the rain no longer an annoyance but a gentle reminder of the beauty we often miss
chunks.zh: 雨水不再是烦恼，而是常被我们错过的美丽的一种温柔提醒
chunks.function: with 复合结构作伴随状语

points.explanation: with + 宾语 + 宾语补足语 (名词/形容词/分词/介词短语等) 在句中作伴随状语，使句子紧凑。本句 with the rain no longer an annoyance but a gentle reminder... 中，the rain 为宾语，no longer an annoyance but a gentle reminder 是互补的名词短语作补足语。
points.example_sentence: I walked home slowly, with the rain no longer an annoyance but a gentle reminder of the beauty we often miss.
points.common_mistake: ❌ with the rain no longer annoyance (缺少冠词) → ✅ with the rain no longer an annoyance (可数名词单数须加冠词)
points.contrast: with 复合结构既可表伴随，也可表原因、方式等。它与独立主格结构相似，但 with 复合结构更口语化，且逻辑主语前须保留 with。例如：He fell asleep with the light on. (on 为副词)
